biography:
Samidha has led the acquisition and ground-up development of projects valued at over $5 billion including 1,400 apartment units, 6 million square feet of office and over 800 condominium units. She is passionate about the use of innovation and technology in real estate. She has led the piloting and adoption of technologies to enhance site safety, building design and environmental leadership in her projects. 
She currently serves as Co-Chair of the ULI San Francisco Innovation Council and is also the founder and host of Bricks & Bytes, a virtual talk series on ULI that features thought-leaders' perspectives on the transformation of real estate through innovation and technology.
